description: This file extends the Duration prototype with various methods for manipulation, conversion, and formatting of duration objects. It imports functions from other modules and assigns them to the prototype, enabling method chaining on Duration instances.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Prototype of Duration class, extended with various methods for duration manipulation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the duration object is valid.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the duration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a specified duration or amount to the current duration.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts a specified duration or amount from the current duration.

methods.name: as
methods.description: Returns the duration expressed in the specified units.

methods.name: asMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: asSeconds
methods.description: Returns the duration in seconds.

methods.name: asMinutes
methods.description: Returns the duration in minutes.

methods.name: asHours
methods.description: Returns the duration in hours.

methods.name: asDays
methods.description: Returns the duration in days.

methods.name: asWeeks
methods.description: Returns the duration in weeks.

methods.name: asMonths
methods.description: Returns the duration in months.

methods.name: asQuarters
methods.description: Returns the duration in quarters.

methods.name: asYears
methods.description: Returns the duration in years.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Returns the primitive value of the duration.

methods.name: _bubble
methods.description: Internal method for bubbling up duration adjustments.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the current duration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets specific unit values from the duration.

methods.name: milliseconds
methods.description: Gets the milliseconds component of the duration.

methods.name: seconds
methods.description: Gets the seconds component of the duration.

methods.name: minutes
methods.description: Gets the minutes component of the duration.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Gets the hours component of the duration.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Gets the days component of the duration.

methods.name: weeks
methods.description: Gets the weeks component of the duration.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Gets the months component of the duration.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Gets the years component of the duration.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the duration.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Returns an ISO string representation of the duration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the duration, same as toISOString.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Returns a JSON-friendly string of the duration, same as toISOString.

methods.name: locale
methods.description: Gets or sets the locale of the duration.

methods.name: localeData
methods.description: Returns locale-specific data for the duration.

methods.name: toIsoString
methods.description: Deprecated. Same as toISOString(), maintained for backward compatibility.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Gets or sets language/locale used by the duration.
